title: 不要撞到茶几了
content: Don't bump into the table.

title: 别坐在地上地上又脏又凉
content: Don't sit on the floor. It's dirty and cold.

title: 别把杯子放在桌子边上
content: Don't put your cup on the edge.

title: 不要把手指插进插座里
content: Don't stick your finger in the socket.

title: 你会被电到的
content: It will shock you.

title: 不要在沙发上乱跳
content: Don't jump around on the sofa.

title: 别把脚搭在茶几上
content: Don't put your feet on the table.

title: 别躺在地上不然你会感冒的
content: Don't lie on the floor or you'll catch a cold.

title: 不要对着空调吹
content: Don't stand in front of the AC.

title: 把空调关了吧
content: Turn the AC off.

title: 躺在沙发上休息一下吧
content: Lie down on the sofa and have a rest.

title: 你只能看20分钟哦
content: You can only watch for 20 minutes.

title: 到时间就关喽
content: Turn it off when the time's up.

title: 你知道遥控器在哪吗
content: Do you know where the remote is?

title: 把遥控器递给我
content: Hand me the remote.

title: 我手机没电了
content: My phone is out of power.

title: 它得充会儿电
content: It needs to be charged.

title: 请拿给我
content: Get it for me, please.

title: 说请
content: What's the magic word?

title: 不用谢
content: You're welcome.

title: 不要在客厅拍球
content: Don't bounce the ball in the living room.

title: 轻点不要在地板上跳
content: Don't pound on the floor.

title: 不要大吼大叫
content: Don't shout.

title: 噪音太大会影响楼下邻居
content: You'll disturb the downstairs neighbors.

title: 不要在墙上乱涂乱画
content: Don't scribble on the wall.

title: 把垃圾扔到垃圾桶里
content: Throw your trash in the trash.
